what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 108235 Eritrean refugees in Sudan, 19.5% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia hosts the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Sudan, Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 500000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 502600, at the end of 1992.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1991 to 2002, and the figure was much lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sudan.
These are year-end totals for Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
